limits: Measured paths include their normal result allocation and destruction; no decoded-VIN cache.
Our builds and tests were stopped during timed comparisons; the Mac remained shared with other work.
These rates describe the recorded workloads and API shapes; no cumulative gain is claimed.
Cold probes measure the ordinary Rust result API, not additional first-use JSON template initialization.
rejected: Generic borrowed-result API: about 1.08x single / 1.33x batch in quick tests, but added an API surface; direct JSON avoids it.
Early regular-pattern deduplication: no useful end-to-end improvement.
Per-pattern JSON-row cache: small improvement, extra storage and decode bookkeeping; removed.
